classification: Closed actual prime-to-ell IsSeed construction, retaining original rank-two IsTwist

primary_references.interface: Main Theorem 8.2: smoothed integral measure and integral Kummer congruences; the unit smoothing factor is supplied in the proof.
Definition 4.2, Remark 4.3, Theorem 4.5(1): chi1=1, chi2=chi primitive, level=f=conductor chi; Gauss ratio cancels and extra Euler-factor set is empty.

Sections 1.4-1.6 and Corollary 1.6.2: fine modular curves and integral q-expansion principle. The coarse diamond eigensheaf cusp lift is proved in the note; blanket eigensheaf base change is not cited.
Theorem 6.1 and Lemma 6.11: classical Galois representations and lifting a residual eigenpacket in a finite free DVR module. A specified eigenvector lift is not claimed.
Hypotheses 0.3 and Theorem A. F=Q has odd degree, so no added finite discrete-series place is required. Exact primitive central conductor forces zero monodromy by the conductor argument in the note.

Proposition 17.1 and Section 17.7, no residual irreducibility. The cohomological unramified line has arithmetic Frobenius alpha^{-1}; its dual gives the arithmetic normalization's unramified quotient alpha.
Theorem 9.3 and Remark 9.9: adjoint transfer with cuspidality outside the quadratic self-twist case.
Chapter III Theorems 4.2(a,b) and 5.1: cyclic prime-degree cuspidal base change and strong local compatibility; iterate from K to the original L. No solvable descent is used.

conclusions: The prime-to-ell order assumption is the actual SeedPtOf174-179 input, not a consequence of conductor prime to ell. Unrestricted Seed2/Seed3 are not claimed. The original nonquadratic residual condition and all fields are retained.

The order-ell character theta has prime conductor w, w=1 mod ell. Nontrivial residual phi permits a unit smoothing factor with a=1 mod w*ell. Deligne-Ribet8.2 applied to primitive and imprimitive functions retains the missing w Euler factor and proves divisibility using phi(w)=1, without dividing by k or a Bernoulli denominator.

Dasgupta-Kakde4.2/4.5 specialize with Gauss ratio one and no additional Euler factors. Every non-infinity constant is zero; the remaining constants are unit multiples of L(1-k,chi)/2. Katz1.6.2 supplies integrality on the fine curve. The argument includes ell=3.

The coarse diamond eigensheaf boundary sequence is exact at the cusps because the stabilizer order divides 2C and is invertible. Averaging is only over that stabilizer. No full-group averaging or wild elliptic-point base-change assertion is used.

The invariant generators c4^3 and Delta identify omega^12 with the pullback of the ample finite-j-map line, including its linearization. Serre vanishing in each class modulo12 supplies all sufficiently large required weights. Boundary torsion-freeness makes the cusp lattice saturated and the reduced cusp eigenpacket nonzero.

Deligne-Serre6.11 lifts eigenvalues in that finite free lattice, including T_ell and U_q. The primitive central character forces exact newlevel C=Mw. No auxiliary arithmetic field or level is introduced.

Carayol0.3/Theorem A require no additional discrete-series place over Q. Equality of representation and central-character conductors forces a principal series with one unramified character; special and irreducible Weil cases have larger conductor than their determinant. Actual inertia is 1 plus chi, with zero monodromy, including at2.

Kato17.1/17.7 require no residual irreducibility. The cohomological unramified line has arithmetic Frobenius alpha inverse; its dual gives the stated arithmetic quotient alpha. Since alpha=1 modulo lambda, its residual character is one on the whole decomposition group. The exact ordered inertia weights and residual flags follow.

Characteristic-zero reducibility would give finite-order characters times epsilon^0 and epsilon^(k-1), contradicting the elementary cusp bound for k>2. Chebotarev gives residual characteristic polynomials at every Galois element.

For rank3 the exact adjoint Sym^2(rho)/det(rho) retains all types. The nonquadratic residual condition excludes quadratic self-twists; infinite ordinary projective inertia and the proper-subgroup classification give connected closure PGL2 and irreducibility on every open subgroup. The actual source matrix preserves Q up to det^2, so Q*A(c) supplies the required symmetric pairing.

Gelbart-Jacquet9.3 applies because a nontrivial self-twist would be quadratic. The source geometric Frobenius and algSat3 require exactly epsilon inverse. Arthur-ClozelIII.4.2/III.5.1 are iterated only through the given abelian extension; Schur and subgroup irreducibility exclude the noncuspidal self-twist alternative.

For rank2, phi=chi-prime squared times eta is odd and nontrivial. Sigma=rho*epsilon^(-m)*chi-prime inverse has the exact determinant eta*theta. Finite-index Clifford theory and the residual square condition prove irreducibility on G_L. J*sigma(c) is symmetric with conjugate multiplier1.

The final rank2 automorphic representation is BC(pi_f dual)*|det|^(1/2)*Xi_chi*Xi. Its algSat2 and geometric Frobenius agree. The supplied IsTwist infinity types(-1,0), combined with the half-norm, give the two displayed regular C-algebraic parameter sets. An unsupported intermediate untwisted regular-algebraicity assertion was removed in review.
The pairing multipliers epsilon^(-2) and epsilon^(-1) cancel exactly the two corresponding algSat factors. Strong multiplicity one gives conjugate self-duality. The original ka is retained.
